messages.subject: Open windows with shiny server.
parts:

Once again, Thanks for all.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Open windows with shiny server.
parts: This only works if you run locally: it's browseURL(). But why don't you want to use JavaScript? It's the only way to get this working when serving the app remotely.
